old: C'est loin d'une disparition, vous ne trouvez pas ?
new: On est loin d'une disparition, vous ne trouvez pas ?
reason: 'C'est loin d'une disparition' is unidiomatic; natural French is 'On est loin de X' (or 'C'est loin d'être une disparition')

old: et l'égalité progresse désormais jusque dans les postes de direction
new: et l'égalité progresse désormais jusqu'au sommet des entreprises
reason: Copé-Zimmermann quotas apply to boards (conseils d'administration), not executive/management posts (that is the 2021 loi Rixain); wording aligned with FR002

old: and equality is now progressing even into management positions
new: and equality is now progressing right up to the top of companies
reason: keeps EN matching the corrected French

old: but they could not justify depriving citizens of fundamental rights
new: but they cannot justify depriving citizens of fundamental rights
reason: 'ne sauraient justifier' is present-tense 'cannot (possibly) justify'; 'could not' reads as past/conditional

old: I would probably feel responsible (motivated / under pressure)
new: I would probably feel accountable (motivated / under pressure)
reason: 'responsabilisé' = given responsibility/accountable; 'feel responsible' in English means 'feel to blame'

old: defend so passionately a free time that has become a hard-won right
new: defend so passionately free time that has become a hard-won right
reason: 'free time' is uncountable in English: 'a free time' is ungrammatical

old: leaving aside those in insecure work and the self-employed
new: leaving out those in insecure work and the self-employed
reason: 'laissant de côté' here = excluding (leaving out); 'leaving aside' means 'disregarding' in English (chunk gloss already says 'to leave X out')
